data.name: Perla
data.gender_notes: Perla is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Bible, Perla is derived from the Latin word 'perlarium' meaning 'pearl'. Pearls symbolize purity, innocence, and spiritual growth. In the parable of the pearl of great price, a merchant sells all his possessions to buy a pearl of great value. The name Perla carries the meaning “Pearl of great price” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Perla usually hope their child will grow to embody pearl of great price and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of spiritual growth and worth
data.etymology: Perla belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pearl of great price.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Perla total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: פרלה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פרלה הוא שם שמקורו ביהדות ומשמעותו פנינה יקרה ונדירה, המסמלת את האהבה והחסד של אלוהים. השם פרלה קשור לפנינים שמהן עשויה היופי והערך הרב של הנוצרי.

in_greek.name: Πέρλα
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Πέρλα είναι όνομα που σχετίζεται με το μαργαρίτη, σύμβολο της πνευματικής σοφίας και της αγιότητας. Στην παράδοση των Ανατολικών Ορθοδόξων Εκκλησιών, το μαργαρίτη θεωρείται πολύτιμος λίθος που αντιπροσωπεύει την πνευματική αγνότητα και τη σοφία.

in_latin.name: Perla
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Perla derivatur a margarita, quae symbolum est sapientiae spiritualis et sanctitatis. In traditione Ecclesiae Christianorum, margarita habetur lapis pretiosus qui repraesentat puritatem spiritualem et sapientiam.

in_english.name: Perla
in_english.meaning: a precious pearl symbolizing spiritual wisdom and love
in_english.long_meaning: The name Perla originates from the Hebrew and Greek roots, meaning 'pearl', which symbolizes spiritual wisdom, love, and purity. In Christian tradition, the pearl is considered a precious stone representing spiritual richness and devotion. Historically, the name Perla has been used across various Christian cultures, signifying a person's value and beauty in the eyes of God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Perla has a rich cultural significance, originating from the Latin word 'perlarium', meaning 'pearl'. Pearls have been treasured throughout history for their beauty, rarity, and value. In various cultures and religions, pearls symbolize wisdom, wealth, and eternal life.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian tradition, the name Perla holds deep spiritual significance derived from the pearl in the parable of the pearl of great price (Matthew 13:45-46). This parable tells the story of a merchant in search of fine pearls, who, upon finding one of great value, sells all his possessions to buy it. The pearl in this parable represents the Kingdom of Heaven, worth sacrificing all worldly possessions to acquire. The name Perla, therefore, serves as a reminder to cherish and prioritize spiritual values and growth over material wealth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Perla, meaning pearl in Latin, represents the hidden beauty and value within each individual. It symbolizes the inner transformation and purification, much like a pearl forms around a grain of sand in an oyster. In Christianity, it is a reminder of the preciousness of each soul in God's eyes.

historical_references.reference: According to legend, Perla was a sixth century B.C. Greek princess who, after being shipwrecked off the coast of modern-day Israel, was miraculously saved and converted to Christianity by Saint George the Martyr. She became a prominent figure in Christian folklore and was venerated as a patron saint of sailors and travelers.
historical_references.time_period: Sixth Century B.C. - Sixth Century A.D.

historical_references.reference: Perla was also the name of a medieval European saint, believed to have lived in the fourth century A.D. She was a noblewoman in Rome who was martyred for refusing to renounce her faith during the persecutions of Diocletian. Her relics were later venerated in various European towns, and she became a patron saint of pearl divers and pregnant women.

trends: minimalist jewelry, pearls as a symbol of purity and elegance
modern_usage.modern_context: Perla, a classic and timeless name, has seen a modern resurgence in various contexts, particularly in the realm of fashion and jewelry. In recent times, the name has been associated with minimalist jewelry trends, where pearls are used as a symbol of purity and elegance. The name Perla is a popular search term on Instagram, where influencers and brands showcase stunning pearl jewelry pieces. Pinterest, a visual discovery engine, is another platform where Perla-inspired pearl jewelry content is abundant, with pins ranging from DIY pearl necklaces to high-end designer pieces. Lastly, on Etsy, an online marketplace for handmade and vintage goods, buyers can find unique Perla-inspired pearl jewelry from independent sellers, reflecting the name's enduring appeal.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Mary Perla in London, United Kingdom credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Perla, which means "Pearl of great price". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
